description: This file defines the implementation of the OpenWrt class, a command source for launching and managing an OpenWrt virtual machine within the Cuttlefish project. It includes logic for configuring VM parameters, handling snapshots, and integrating with the Cuttlefish configuration system.

classes.name: OpenWrt
classes.description: A command source class responsible for configuring and launching an OpenWrt VM instance within the Cuttlefish environment.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Generates a sequence of commands to set up and run the OpenWrt VM, including handling snapshots, network configuration, and boot parameters.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this command source, 'OpenWrt'.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Determines if the OpenWrt command source should be active based on the current configuration and boot flow.
